# SCENE AND MICRO-LOCATION MASTER REGISTER — Chapter 1, verbatim NPC capture (v1.9)

Captured from the Google Drive register `SCENE_AND_MICROLOCATION_MASTER_REGISTER.md` v1.9 (2026-11-15),
Drive file id `1EYQl5eMZx8PGElDSPHojKcEVWGvU2-UW`, read 2026-11-16.

WHY THIS FILE EXISTS SEPARATELY
--------------------------------
`scene_register_ch01_full.md` is preserved unchanged. It carries 46 summary
rows but only five detail blocks, and its detail blocks are ABRIDGED: its
CH01-SCN-017 reads "Three adults." where the register reads "Six to ten
adults; Unoka (storyteller) some days." That divergence is recorded in
`Docs/SCENE_CAPTURE_W2M2.md` and guarded by a regression test. This file is
the verbatim capture and supersedes it as the population-budget source.

WHAT IS VERBATIM AND WHAT IS NOT
--------------------------------
* `NPCs present` strings below are copied character-for-character from the
  register. They are the ONLY field this capture asserts.
* The summary table is reused from the existing fixture, which matched the
  register's own Summary block.
* A scene with NO detail block here was simply not read verbatim. It is not
  "zero NPCs". Absence of a block means UNCAPTURED, never empty.
